## Repeat visits (RTT 100 ms, TTL 5 s)

| Visit | Load time (s) | Proxy log outcomes |
|---|---|---|
| Visit 1 - empty cache | 3.035 | 21 MISS |
| Visit 2 - fresh cache | 0.011 | 21 HIT |
| Visit 3 - stale, unchanged | 3.360 | 21 REVALIDATE_304 |
| Visit 4 - stale, 5 objects changed | 3.231 | 5 REVALIDATE_200, 16 REVALIDATE_304 |

## Cache hit ratio (5 consecutive page loads, TTL 3600 s)

| Page load | Hits | Misses |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 21 |
| 2 | 21 | 0 |
| 3 | 21 | 0 |
| 4 | 21 | 0 |
| 5 | 21 | 0 |

Overall: (HIT + REVALIDATE_304) / GET = 0.800 over 105 GET requests.
